title: fix(docs): prevent publishing incomplete API references
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The merged OpenAPI schema now records whether Gen, Enter and Media each contributed public operations. API reference regeneration rejects failed schema fetches or a schema missing any of those three sources, preventing a partial reference from being published while leaving the docs endpoint available. Before updating the reference PR, the workflow compares method-and-path pairs against the published reference; if operations disappeared, it disables auto-merge before pushing, lists the removals in the PR, and fails the run with a link for manual review.
